body:
Anyone who cares about the issues I raise in my new book will also learn to care deeply about the situation in Israel and Palestine. Here are some excellent articles on the subject, by people I trust:

An important letter from Christian leaders – and an invitation to add your name to theirs:

 http://www.kairosusa.org/?q=node/55#overlay-context=node/60%3Fq%3Dnode/60&utm_source=KUSA+Oct+2012+NL&utm_campaign=October+Newsletter&utm_medium=email

And then a piece on responses to that letter:

 http://www.kairosusa.org/?q=node/62#overlay-context=node/56%3Fq%3Dnode/56&utm_source=KUSA+Oct+2012+NL&utm_campaign=October+Newsletter&utm_medium=email

And don’t miss this profile of a Wheaton College professor named Gary Burge who has needed perspectives on Israel and Palestine:
